descricao_original: Cytokinesis produces gametes (ova or sperm), each containing one set of chromosomes (haploid, 1N). However, while the nuclear events producing ova (oogenesis) and sperm (spermatogenesis) are similar, cytoplasmic stages are different between these processes.

marcadores.explicacao_original: In males, a single germ cell undergoing meiosis produces four sperm. In females, only a single ovum is formed, along with two or three nonfunctional cells called polar bodies.
